en.name: Sesame oil
en.summary: Unopened sesame oil keeps 2 years from purchase in a cool dark cupboard, and about 6 months once opened. It fails by going rancid rather than by growing anything, and the aroma that makes toasted sesame oil worth having fades well before that.
en.pantry: 2 years from purchase unopened and about 6 months after opening, in a dark cupboard away from the hob with the cap tight. Sesame oil is naturally more stable than most seed oils because the seeds carry sesamol and related antioxidants, which is part of why a bottle of 麻油 keeps as long as it does. But toasted sesame oil is bought for its aroma, and aroma is volatile: a bottle that has been open for a year in a warm kitchen often smells flat long before it smells rancid, and it is no longer doing the job you bought it for. Cold-pressed, untoasted sesame oil is paler, milder and used as a cooking oil rather than a finishing one.
en.fridge: No refrigerated timeline is published for sesame oil. Refrigeration will slow both the oxidation and the aroma loss, and it is a sensible home for a bottle you use only for finishing a dish now and then — Taiwanese kitchens are warm and humid for much of the year, which is exactly the condition that ages an oil. It may cloud or thicken in the cold, which is harmless and reverses at room temperature. For the bottle of 麻油 you cook with weekly, a cool cupboard is enough.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for sesame oil and freezing serves no useful purpose. Oil does not set solid the way water does, so there is no convenience gained, and a bottle taken in and out of a freezer collects condensation — and water in an oil bottle is a genuine problem, because it gives spoilage organisms something to work with.
en.thawing: Let a chilled bottle stand at room temperature until it is clear and pours freely. Do not warm it over the hob; heat is one of the four things that age an oil.
spoilage: No toasted aroma at all when the cap comes off — the first and commonest failure.
A sharp, crayon or paint-like smell, which is rancidity and is decisive.
A bitter, scratchy finish at the back of the throat.
A sticky, varnish-like film around the neck of the bottle.
tips: Buy small bottles; toasted sesame oil is bought for aroma, and aroma fades.
Add it off the heat at the end of cooking, not at the start.
Keep it away from the hob — the cupboard above the stove is the worst place for it.
Untoasted sesame oil is for cooking; toasted is for finishing. They are not interchangeable.

faq.q: How long does sesame oil last?
faq.a: 2 years from purchase unopened, and about 6 months once opened, kept cool, dark and tightly capped.

faq.q: Does sesame oil need to be refrigerated?
faq.a: No timeline is published for it, but the fridge slows both oxidation and aroma loss and suits a bottle used only occasionally. It may cloud in the cold, which is harmless.

faq.q: My sesame oil smells of nothing — is it bad?
faq.a: It is not necessarily rancid, but it has lost the aroma you bought it for. Rancidity smells sharp and crayon-like; a flat bottle simply has nothing left to give.

zh.name: 麻油
zh.summary: 未開封的麻油自購買日起可放 2 年，開封後大約 6 個月，要放陰涼避光處。它的失敗方式是油耗而不是長東西；而讓麻油值得存在的那股香氣，往往在油耗之前很久就先跑光了。
zh.pantry: 未開封自購買日起 2 年、開封後約 6 個月，放遠離爐火的陰暗櫃子，瓶蓋鎖緊。麻油天生比多數種子油穩定，因為芝麻本身帶有芝麻酚一類的抗氧化成分——這也是一瓶麻油能放這麼久的部分原因。但焙煎麻油買的是香氣，而香氣是揮發性的：一瓶在溫暖廚房裡開了一年的麻油，常常在還沒油耗之前就已經聞起來平淡無味，那時它已經不再做你當初買它的那份工作了。冷壓、未焙煎的芝麻油顏色較淡、味道溫和，用途是炒菜而不是起鍋提香。
zh.fridge: 麻油沒有公布的冷藏期限。冷藏能同時拖慢氧化和香氣流失，對一瓶只偶爾用來起鍋提香的油來說是合理的位置——台灣的廚房一年有大半時間又熱又濕，而那正是讓油老化的條件。低溫下它可能變濁或變稠，那是無害的，回到室溫就恢復。至於每週都在用的那瓶麻油，放陰涼的櫃子就夠了。
zh.freezer: 麻油沒有公布的冷凍期限，冷凍也沒有實際用途。油不像水那樣會凍成硬塊，所以使用上沒有任何方便；而一瓶進出冷凍的油只會一直結露——油瓶裡有水是真正的問題，因為那等於給了腐敗菌可以利用的東西。
zh.thawing: 把冰過的瓶子放室溫，等它恢復清澈、倒得順即可。不要拿去爐火上加溫；熱是讓油老化的四件事之一。
spoilage: 開蓋完全聞不到焙煎香——最早也最常見的失敗。
聞起來刺鼻、像蠟筆或油漆味，那就是油耗，而且是決定性的。
入口後喉頭有苦味和刮喉感。
瓶頸周圍出現黏黏、像亮光漆的膜。
tips: 買小瓶；麻油買的是香氣，而香氣會褪。
起鍋前離火再淋，不要一開始就下鍋。
遠離爐火——爐台上方的櫃子是它最糟的歸宿。
未焙煎的芝麻油拿來炒，焙煎麻油拿來提香，兩者不能互換。

faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 2 年，開封後大約 6 個月，要陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊。
它沒有公布冷藏期限，但冷藏能同時拖慢氧化和香氣流失，適合只偶爾用的那瓶。低溫下可能變濁，那是無害的。

faq.q: 我的麻油聞起來沒味道，是壞了嗎？
faq.a: 不一定是油耗，但它已經失去你當初買它的那股香氣。油耗會刺鼻、帶蠟筆味；聞起來平淡的那瓶，只是已經沒東西可以給了。
